revisions.cause: The harness checked thread liveness immediately after successfully killing the timed-out Moli process, falsely quarantining the adapter during cleanup.
revisions.correction: Allow only Moli up to one second of post-cancellation cleanup outside the 45-second answer budget.
revisions.replacement_scope: All 100 Moli cases; do not append only the missing cases and do not select between old and new outputs.
